articles.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
articles.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.
articles.titleJa: 石油価格、米イランの攻撃停止で急落
articles.summary: 米国とイランが攻撃を停止し、対話の余地が生まれたことで石油価格が急落。紛争解決への期待が高まっています。

articles.title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle

articles.title: Pirlo out of Italy football top job after backlash over Russian betting firm links
articles.description: The uproar throws the Italian Football Federation into further disarray following Italy's third consecutive failure to qualify for the World Cup.

articles.titleJa: ネタニヤフ首相、逮捕示唆後NY市長を「憎悪を煽る」と非難

articles.title: Millions see leaked copy of The Odyssey movie on X
articles.description: Film studio Universal takes down a high-quality bootleg version of the film, which appeared on X.
articles.titleJa: 映画『オデッセイ』の流出コピーがXで数百万人に視聴される
articles.summary: 映画スタジオ「ユニバーサル」は、X（旧Twitter）に高画質の海賊版『オデッセイ』が投稿され、数百万人に視聴されたため、削除措置をとった。

articles.summary: 米当局は、ビザの不法滞在と複数回の逮捕歴を理由に、ケニア出身の元NFL選手ダニエル・アドンゴ氏を強制送還した。

articles.title: UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
articles.description: The Ukrainian president will be the new prime minister's first international visitor since taking office.

articles.title: Argentine leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
articles.description: Javier Milei spoke at a campaign rally for right-wing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running against Lula.

articles.summary: アルゼンチン大統領ハビエル・ミレイが、ブラジルの選挙集会で、現ブラジル大統領を「泥棒」や「前科者」と非難した。

articles.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
articles.description: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin.

articles.summary: ベルリン西部の警察作戦中、プライド攻撃容疑者アブドゥル・バロットがナイフを手に警官に襲いかかり、射殺された。

articles.title: How India's Gen-Z protesters shifted the political debate
articles.description: The resignation of India's education minister amounts to a stunning victory for the youth-led "Cockroach" protest movement. The bigger question is if this political momentum turns into a lasting platform for more reform.
articles.titleJa: インドのZ世代デモ隊はいかに政治議論を転換させたか
articles.summary: インドの教育大臣辞任は、Z世代主導の「ゴキブリ」抗議運動にとって驚くべき勝利となった。この政治的勢いが改革への永続的な足場となるかが問われている。

articles.title: Germany: Islamist terror attack on Berlin Pride parade triggers political debate
articles.description: Following the terrorist attack on Berlin's Pride parade, the Christopher Street Day parade, politicians and security experts are demanding consequences.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ：ベルリンのプライドパレードに対するイスラム過激派のテロ攻撃が政治論争を巻き起こす
articles.summary: ベルリンのプライドパレードへのテロ攻撃後、政治家や治安専門家が対策を要求し、政治論争が活発化している。

articles.title: 'Amnesia' about measles risk and low vaccination rates have helped US infections grow
articles.description: The latest US data shows measles cases up to mid-July 2026 totaled more than all the cases in 2025. Experts blame a fall in vaccination and warn people have forgotten measles can be life-threatening.

articles.title: FIFA boss Infantino takes aim at World Cup critics
articles.description: In a strongly worded open statement, FIFA President Gianni Infantino has hit out at those he says were too "consumed by hate and criticism" to enjoy the tournament. Infantino brushed off a number of corruption concerns.
articles.titleJa: FIFA会長インファンティーノ、ワールドカップ批判者に対抗
articles.summary: FIFA会長ジャンニ・インファンティーノは、ワールドカップを批判する人々を非難し、汚職疑惑を一蹴する声明を発表した。

articles.title: Iran rules out US talks as Hormuz Strait remains closed
articles.description: Iran has not asked to resume talks with the US, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said. He added that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed and that messages are being relayed through mediators. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: イラン、ホルムズ海峡閉鎖のまま米国との協議を拒否
articles.summary: イラン外務省報道官は米国との協議再開を求めておらず、ホルムズ海峡は閉鎖されたままで、仲介者を通じてメッセージが伝えられていると述べた。

articles.title: Car ramming attacks: Why do they keep happening?
articles.description: Cars are being used as weapons, to ram, kill and maim innocent people. The reasons why are not always clear, nor are solutions to preventing such attacks.
articles.titleJa: 車による突入攻撃：なぜ繰り返されるのか？
articles.summary: 車が武器として無実の人々を襲い、殺傷する事件が頻発している。その理由や予防策は不明な点が多く、解決策は見つかっていない。

articles.title: France: Macron holds crisis talks as wildfires spread
articles.description: As France and Spain battle some of their worst wildfires in years, the French government is holding a crisis meeting. A fire-generated storm cloud over France has added to fears of more outbreaks.
articles.titleJa: フランス：山火事拡大を受けマクロン大統領が危機協議を開催
articles.summary: フランスとスペインで過去最悪級の山火事が広がる中、フランス政府は危機協議を開催。火災による嵐雲が発生し、さらなる被害への懸念が高まっている。

articles.title: The plague is as deadly today as in the Middle Ages
articles.description: Most people have only heard of the plague as the disease that ravaged Europe in the Middle Ages. But it's still around today, such as in Madagascar, and just as lethal as ever.
articles.titleJa: ペストは中世と同じくらい今日でも致命的である
articles.summary: ペストは中世ヨーロッパを荒廃させた病として知られるが、現在もマダガスカルなどで発生しており、当時と同様に致命的である。

articles.title: Germany: Berlin Pride attack prompts calls for clampdown
articles.description: German conservatives are calling for a tougher course on suspected Islamists after the deadly Christopher Street Day attack in Berlin. The presumed attacker was released from detention this May. DW has the latest.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ：ベルリンのプライド攻撃が取り締まり強化の要求を促す
articles.summary: ベルリンでのクリストファー・ストリート・デーの襲撃事件後、ドイツの保守派はイスラム過激派容疑者への厳格な対応を求めている。

articles.title: India news: Greta Thunberg expresses solidarity with CJP protesters
articles.description: Greta Thunberg attended a celebratory rally organized by Indian students in London after major successes for the CJP movement. Follow DW for more.
articles.titleJa: インドのニュース：グレタ・トゥーンベリ、CJP抗議者と連帯を表明
articles.summary: CJP運動の大成功後、グレタ・トゥーンベリがロンドンで開催されたインド人学生による祝賀集会に出席し、連帯を表明した。

articles.title: Uganda begins emergency food handouts after 19 die from hunger
articles.description:
Government move follows months of drought and crop failures in Karamoja, with 1.5m people facing malnutrition
Uganda has launched emergency food relief distribution after at least 19 deaths from hunger were reported in an area of prolonged drought in the east of the country.
A crisis has been building in the Karamoja region of Uganda as crops have failed without the season’s expected rains, leaving the region’s 1.5 million people facing acute food shortages and rising malnutrition.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ、飢餓による19人の死者を受け緊急食料支援を開始
articles.summary: ウガンダ政府は、干ばつと作物不作によりカラモジャ地域で19人が飢餓で死亡したことを受け、緊急食料配給を開始。150万人が栄養失調に直面している。

articles.title: Two Russian men jailed in Angola for terrorism and spying
articles.description:
The men were convicted over alleged plan to stage coup and organise deadly demonstrations over fuel prices last year
Two Russian men have been found guilty by an Angolan court of terrorism and spying after being accused of planning a coup and helping to organise deadly demonstrations in the southern African country last year.
Lev Lakshtanov and Igor Ratchin were sentenced to eight and 11 years in jail respectively. They had denied the charges, claiming they were in Angola for cultural and business activities.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アンゴラでロシア人男性2名がテロとスパイ行為で投獄
articles.summary: アンゴラの裁判所は、昨年クーデターを計画し、燃料価格をめぐるデモを組織したとして告発されたロシア人男性2名にテロとスパイ行為の有罪判決を下した。

articles.title: MoD cancels army training in Kenya over powers to prosecute British soldiers
articles.description:
September exercise called off after Kenya raises concerns over funding and jurisdiction for criminal offences
The British army has been forced to cancel training for its troops in Kenya after the Kenyan government refused to ratify a bilateral defence agreement.
While the UK government wanted to renew the existing agreement, Kenyan lawmakers had sought changes to give local authorities greater powers to hold British soldiers accountable for any offences committed in the country.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ケニア、英兵の訴追権限をめぐり国防省が陸軍演習を中止
articles.summary: ケニア政府が二国間防衛協定の批准を拒否したため、英国国防省はケニアでの陸軍訓練を中止した。ケニアは英兵の犯罪に対する訴追権限の強化を求めていた。

articles.title: Health worker monitored for Ebola in London hospital after working in DRC
articles.description:
UK resident was evacuated from Democratic Republic of the Congo where there is an outbreak of the disease
A humanitarian worker is being monitored at a specialist hospital in London after potential exposure to the Ebola virus.
The UK resident was medically evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) where the worker had been treating patients with the disease, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) said.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国での活動後、エボラ出血熱疑いの医療従事者がロンドンの病院で監視下に
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国で活動した人道支援者が、エボラウイルスに曝露した可能性があり、ロンドンの専門病院で監視を受けている。

articles.title: Healthy diet too expensive for one in three people globally, UN report finds
articles.description:
Global hunger declined for the third year in a row in 2025 but experts call for action to bring down costs of fruit, vegetables and dairy as report shows 2.69bn people can’t afford to eat well
One in three people cannot afford to eat a healthy diet, a new report has found, prompting calls for urgent action on food affordability.
There are 2.69 billion people unable to afford a diverse diet that meets their energy and nutrient needs, and it will take “immense” amounts of work to achieve the global target of zero hunger by 2030, the annual report from five UN agencies warned.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 国連報告書、世界人口の3人に1人が健康的な食事を摂るには高すぎると指摘
articles.summary: 国連の報告書によると、世界人口の3分の1が健康的な食事を摂る余裕がなく、26.9億人が必要な栄養を摂取できていない。食料価格の引き下げに向けた緊急の行動が求められている。

articles.title: Venezuelan men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail
articles.description:
Exclusive: CSI Aviation and GlobalX accused of violating civil rights as part of Trump immigration crackdown
Venezuelan men sent last year to a notorious Salvadorian terrorism prison by the Trump administration are suing the US aviation companies that transported them there.
A lawsuit filed this week in federal court in Washington DC accuses the companies CSI Aviation and GlobalX of violating the Venezuelans’ civil rights, false imprisonment, intentional infliction of emotional distress, negligence and other violations, for their role in flying the three planes that took the men to El Salvador.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ人男性ら、悪名高いエルサルバドル刑務所へ移送した航空会社を提訴
articles.summary: トランプ政権下で悪名高いエルサルバドルの刑務所に送られたベネズエラ人男性らが、移送に関わった米国の航空会社を市民権侵害などで提訴した。

articles.title: Thousands of lightning strikes trigger fresh wildfires in western Canada
articles.description:
At least 90 active blazes in British Columbia in what PM says is one of the country’s most intense seasons on record

How dangerous are wildfires and how can we stop them from getting worse?

Fresh wildfires have broken out in western Canada and forests continued to ⁠burn in Ontario as the country ⁠battled what the prime ​minister, Mark Carney, called one of the most intense wildfire seasons on record.
Nearly 34,000 lightning strikes over the past week led to a series of fires ⁠and evacuation orders in southern British Columbia. There were 25 evacuation orders and 90 active wildfires in the province as of Friday morning, and authorities said warming ⁠and drying conditions could cause them to grow.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダ西部で数千回の落雷が新たな山火事を引き起こす
articles.summary: カナダ西部で数千回の落雷により新たな山火事が発生し、ブリティッシュコロンビア州では90件の火災が活動中。同国史上最も激しい山火事シーズンの一つとされている。

articles.title: Guyanese authorities confirm death of 72 people in sinking of coastal ferry
articles.description:
Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 were rescued as efforts continue to salvage the ship and recover all bodies
The confirmed death toll from the recent capsizing of a state ferry off Guyana’s coast has risen to 72, with more bodies recovered as a multinational team struggle to salvage the partially submerged vessel.
Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 people were rescued. The government has estimated that 100 may have died in the accident, which would make it the worst marine tragedy on record for the South American nation.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ガイアナ当局、沿岸フェリー沈没で72人の死亡を確認
articles.summary: ガイアナ沖で発生したフェリー沈没事故で、確認された死者数は72人に増加した。乗船者179人のうち76人が救助されたが、行方不明者の捜索と船体の引き揚げ作業が続いている。

articles.title: Canadian government urged to block Thomson Reuters data deal with US ICE
articles.description:
US agency is to pay Canadian media company US$125m for use of investigative database to detect ‘immigration fraud’
A Canadian federal opposition party leader has called on Mark Carney’s government to block the latest data-sharing deal between US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the Canadian media company Thomson Reuters.
Avi Lewis, the federal leader of the New Democratic party (NDP), demanded on Tuesday that Ottawa address the contract and further restrict Canadian corporations from doing business with ICE, after Canada’s National Observer news website reported on the deal.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダ政府、トムソン・ロイターと米国ICEのデータ取引阻止を求める声
articles.summary: カナダの野党党首は、トムソン・ロイターが米国移民税関捜査局(ICE)にデータを提供する契約をカナダ政府が阻止するよう求めた。契約は1億2500万ドル規模で、移民詐欺検出に利用される。

articles.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local leaders
articles.description:
Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon
Indigenous leaders on the Brazilian-Peruvian border have said their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying rainforest, building roads and trafficking drugs.
Earlier this month, masked men armed with semi-automatic weapons entered homes in Apiwtxa, a village in the Kampa do Rio Amônia Indigenous territory, intimidating people and searching for targets.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: マスクの男たちがアマゾン共同体を「人質」に、組織犯罪が急増と地元指導者
articles.summary: ブラジルとペルーの国境地帯で、武装した組織犯罪集団が先住民コミュニティを「人質」に取り、森林破壊や麻薬密売を行っていると地元指導者が訴え、ブラジリアへ代表団を派遣した。

articles.title: A new Hello Kitty ‘hotel’ in Tokyo allows guests to check-in but not stay
articles.description: At this hotel-inspired exhibition in Tokyo, Sanrio fans can check-in with a room key, explore rooms, a garden and beach zone, but can’t stay the night.
articles.titleJa: 東京に新しいハローキティ「ホテル」が登場、宿泊はできないがチェックインは可能
articles.summary: 東京にオープンしたハローキティをテーマにした展示施設は、ゲストがルームキーでチェックインし、部屋や庭、ビーチゾーンを探索できるが、宿泊はできない。

articles.title: One year on, is the Turnberry deal already at risk?
articles.description: As the EU-US trade deal marks its first anniversary, fresh threats from US President Donald Trump have put it under renewed pressure. How serious are they, and what can the EU do if they materialise? Euronews takes a closer look.
articles.titleJa: 1年後、ターンベリー合意はすでに危機に瀕しているのか？
articles.summary: EUと米国の貿易協定が1周年を迎える中、ドナルド・トランプ米大統領からの新たな脅威により、この合意は再び圧力下に置かれている。

articles.title: This European airline is offering free ‘teddy trackers’ for families travelling this summer
articles.description: Giving them one less thing to worry about when travelling, parents can keep track of their child’s beloved stuffed toy using this complimentary tile tracker.
articles.titleJa: この夏、ヨーロッパの航空会社が家族旅行向けに無料の「テディトラッカー」を提供
articles.summary: あるヨーロッパの航空会社が、この夏に旅行する家族向けに、子供のぬいぐるみを追跡できる無料のタイル型トラッカーを提供し、旅行中の心配事を一つ減らす。

articles.title: Police seize more than 2.6 tonnes of cocaine in Atlantic off coast of Portugal
articles.description: Italian, Spanish and Portuguese police intercepted a high-speed boat in the Atlantic with over 2.6 tonnes of cocaine; four suspects were arrested.
articles.titleJa: ポルトガル沖の大西洋で警察が2.6トン以上のコカインを押収
articles.summary: イタリア、スペイン、ポルトガルの警察が協力し、ポルトガル沖の大西洋で高速ボートを阻止。2.6トン以上のコカインを押収し、4人の容疑者を逮捕した。

articles.title: Varta files for insolvency as German battery maker’s crisis deepens
articles.description: Varta said it faces no immediate threat of failing to meet its payment obligations. Production is continuing, while wages and salaries will still be paid.
articles.titleJa: ドイツのバッテリーメーカー、ヴァルタが経営危機深刻化で破産申請
articles.summary: ドイツのバッテリーメーカーVartaは、経営危機が深まる中で破産申請を行った。しかし、当面の支払い義務履行に支障はなく、生産と給与支払いは継続される。

articles.title: Italian con artist jailed for building 'world's oldest and largest amphitheatre' 20-years ago
articles.description: In Italy, a structure promoted for years as an "ancient Roman amphitheatre" has turned out to be a fake, constructed recently using modern materials.
articles.titleJa: イタリアの詐欺師、20年前に「世界最古最大の円形劇場」を建設したとして投獄される
articles.summary: イタリアで長年「古代ローマの円形劇場」として宣伝されてきた建造物が、実際には近代的な素材で作られた偽物と判明。建設した詐欺師が投獄された。

articles.title: FIFA boss Infantino tells critics to 'meditate' in bizarre Instagram tirade
articles.description: "Finally I am incredibly proud, as FIFA President, to have contributed, even a little, to this show. It's a great feeling," Infantino wrote.

articles.summary: FIFA会長ジャンニ・インファンティーノがインスタグラムで批判者に対し「瞑想しろ」と語る奇妙な投稿を公表し、FIFA会長としてショーに貢献できたことを誇りに思うと述べた。

articles.title: AstraZeneca quarterly net profit rises 2% on strong cancer drug sales
articles.description: Strong cancer drug sales lifted Anglo-Swedish pharmaceutical giant AstraZeneca’s second-quarter earnings above expectations, helping the company maintain its 2026 outlook.
articles.titleJa: アストラゼネカの四半期純利益、強力な抗がん剤販売により2%増加
articles.summary: アングロ・スウェーデン製薬大手アストラゼネカの第2四半期純利益は、強力な抗がん剤販売に支えられ2%増加し、市場予想を上回って2026年までの見通しを維持した。

articles.title: 'Those responsible must face the consequences': Iran again warns Bulgaria over US aircraft deployment
articles.description: Tehran's third warning to Bulgaria came soon after US President Donald Trump publicly thanked Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev for providing air base support.
articles.titleJa: 「責任者は結果に直面すべき」：イラン、米軍機配備を巡りブルガリアに再度警告
articles.summary: ブルガリアが米国に空軍基地支援を提供した後、イランは米軍機配備を巡りブルガリアに対し「責任者は結果に直面すべき」と3度目の警告を発した。

articles.title: Waste pickers work at Indonesia's largest landfill

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?
articles.description: In my previous two posts on the value of the WTO, I argued that when governments set trade policies independently, they focus on domestic effects but often overlook the costs imposed on trading partners. International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
